anchor.quote: A physio-chemical method for use with the device for treating truncal and/or collateral varicose veins

a) Introducing the conduct (2) housing the optical fiber (3) into the inside of the vein or varicose vein (1) until reaching the area to be acted upon, this process being controlled by means of echography

b) Introducing components and medication into the three-way key (52), mixing said components and introducing them via the “T” shaped connection (5) for said medication (51) in the form of foam, inside the channel (4) of the conduct (2)

c) Injecting the medication (51) in the form of foam by means of pressure, it thus passing through the small holes (6) and the front opening (21) in the conduct (2), thereby giving rise to a venous spasm and irritating the venous endothelium, before immediately and/or synergistically firing the laser (31) through the front opening (21) so as to remove the vein (1) by means of heat and subsequently seal it

d) Removing between 1 and 2 mm of the conduct (2), once again repeating the above step c), i.e. injecting medication (51) and immediately firing the laser (31), continuing to do so until treatment of the vein or varicose vein (1) area to be acted upon has been completed
